description: Creates an empty knowledge base. Recipe 'docs' (default) for reference material an agent searches at runtime; 'tabular' for spreadsheet-style data queried with SQL; 'graph' for entity/relationship extraction. After creating, add content with workbench_kb_add_documents, then give an agent flow a search tool over it with workbench_flows_attach_knowledge_base (before publishing the flow). May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

visibility.description: Who can see it: PRIVATE (only the user), WORKSPACE (every member, the default), or SHARED (specific people, granted afterwards). Say 'make it private' → PRIVATE.

name: workbench_kb_create
title: Create a knowledge base
